text:
Application Development Process

Diagram
flowchart TD
  A[Discover needs and goals] --> B[Define requirements and scope]
  B --> C[Design architecture and user experience]
  C --> D[Plan delivery and prioritize work]
  D --> E[Develop and configure]
  E --> F[Integrate systems and data]
  F --> G[Test quality, security, and performance]
  G --> H{Release criteria met?}
  H -- No --> E
  H -- Yes --> I[Deploy and release]
  I --> J[Operate and monitor]
  J --> K[Collect telemetry and feedback]
  K --> L[Maintain, enhance, and improve]
  L --> B
  J --> M{Production issue?}
  M -- Yes --> N[Respond, recover, and learn]
  N --> D
  M -- No --> K
